name: qwen-usage
description: Qwen Cloud Token Plan quota in the VS Code status bar, Codex-badge style

commands.title: Qwen Usage: Open Token Plan Dashboard
Qwen Usage: Read Usage JSON From Clipboard

qwenUsage.curl.markdownDescription: One or more `Copy as cURL` commands (one per line) captured from the Token Plan page's DevTools Network tab, or generated by har-to-curl.js from a HAR export (see README). The extension replays all of them on every poll and merges the results, like the console does. Session cookies expire after a while; re-generate when the badge shows an error.

qwenUsage.extraHeaders.description: Headers merged into every replayed request, e.g. {"cookie": "..."} copied once from a DevTools request's Request Headers. Needed because HAR exports sanitize cookies out of the cURL lines.

qwenUsage.curlFile.description: Optional path to a text file whose lines are cURL commands (e.g. the qwen-curl.txt generated by har-to-curl.js). Combined with qwenUsage.curl.

qwenUsage.pollMinutes.description: How often (in minutes) to re-fetch usage in the background.

qwenUsage.dashboardUrl.description: URL opened by the 'Open Token Plan Dashboard' command.

qwenUsage.lowPercentThreshold.description: Remaining-quota percentage below which the badge turns warning-colored.
